title: Bounded Source Index Lookup
statement: Let $m$ and $L$ be natural numbers, and let $\mathrm{srcs}$ be a list of length $m$ whose entries are all less than $L$. For every $v<m$, the entry of $\mathrm{srcs}$ at index $v$, using $0$ as the default out of range, is less than $L$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of $\mathrm{srcs}$ is less than $L$
